Theme

Latin word

recēns

recēns, recentis

adjective, third declension, one ending · Declension on Wiktionary

fresh; recent, modern; fresh, recent, just made or picked; recent, not long past; fresh

In this lexicon

  • fresh

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. As. 1.3.26: piscis nēquam est, nisi recēns (Lewis & Short); Traupman 69, 71; Traupman 318

  • modern

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. N.D. 2.6: recentiōre memoriā (Lewis & Short); Tac. Ann. 3.18: recentium seu veterum; M-O s.v. modern: recentior

  • new

    also used · classical · Plin. NH 15.82: recentī fīcō; Caes. BG 1.14: recentium injūriārum (Lewis & Short)

  • recent

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. BG 1.14: recentium injūriārum memoriam (Lewis & Short); Cic. Att. 8.15.2: recentissima tua est epistula Kal. data; Traupman 369

  • recēns nātus: newborn

    classical

Examples

  • Tantummodo sī passer recēns est vēnālis hodiē.

    Only if fresh flounder is for sale today.Traupman 69

    In the entry for fresh
